tests_skipped_reason: User reserves usage tests; compilation, packaging and signing only.

manual_request_policy.trigger: Any trusted click captured before normal page click handlers; no label/class/button requirement. Touch/scroll alone and script-generated click do not activate.
manual_request_policy.network: The existing four exact promotional API paths and captured/learned artwork may pass during the manual window. Existing unrelated requests remain unchanged.
manual_request_policy.native: Per-WebView manual window; ServiceWorker and legacy callback use short shared page-origin window where view identity is unavailable.
manual_request_policy.visual: Existing cosmetic rules exempt roots first observed during the window until hidden/disconnected. The two Vue render vetoes allow a manually opened instance through its normal close lifecycle.
limitations: Time correlation is heuristic. Automatic requests and dialogs coincident with a user click can pass.
ServiceWorker and legacy artwork exceptions may affect other 888 tabs for the same brief interval.
Clicks inside unrelated cross-origin frames, new document navigation and requests sent before click capture are not universally attributed.
Reused dialog DOM that closes and reopens without an observable hidden/unmounted state can retain its visual exception.
Site-side conditions and reward eligibility are unchanged; no guarantee all chest actions succeed.
